reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the change preventing TLP markings from carrying over between messages. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #8366 by preventing the FIRST EPSS enrichment connector from reusing a previous message’s TLP marking when evaluating an unmarked vulnerability. **Changes:** - Reset `self.tlp` before checking each entity’s markings. - Add a regression test confirming that an unmarked message is processed after a TLP:RED message is refused. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `internal-enrichment/​first-epss/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_connector.py` | Tests sequential marked and unmarked messages to prevent TLP carryover. | | `internal-enrichment/​first-epss/​src/​internal_enrichment_connector/​connector.py` | Clears the previous TLP value before checking the current entity. |
Review effort: Balanced
